newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle market steady-firm - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle market steady-firm - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady to firm, compared to last test on Thursday, USDA said. Trade slow to moderate. Demand and seller interest moderate. Offerings moderate.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs 67.00-70.00. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1175 lbs 2ld 68.00.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared Mondays close - Slaughter steers and heifers steady in a light test.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1175-1300 lbs 111.50-112.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs 104.00-105.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 106.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 99.00.
Heifers -Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1125-1200 lbs few 112.00.
